server.session.dirGone: The session's folder no longer exists
server.task.pastSession: Past session — send a message to continue
server.task.hubRestarted: The Hub restarted while the task was running
server.bg.forked: Forked from a background session — the original keeps running in the background; this chat continues on the copy.
server.bg.moved: Moved session {id} from the background into the Hub — continue right here.
server.fs.notInHub: The project is not in the Hub
server.fs.outsideProject: The path is outside the project
server.fs.alreadyExists: A file/folder with the same name already exists
server.fs.modifiedElsewhere: The file was just changed elsewhere (Claude or an editor). Reload or overwrite.
server.agent.notConfigured: Agent "{agent}" is not in the Hub config
server.agent.binNotFound: Command "{bin}" not found — install {label} or fix agents.{agent}.bin in hub.config.json
server.cleanup.recentlyActive: recently active (may be open in a terminal)
server.cleanup.trashFailed: could not be moved to the Trash
server.handoff.busy: This chat is running — stop it or wait before switching agents
server.handoff.to: Moved to {agent} — click to open the new chat
server.handoff.briefShown: 📦 Context handoff from {agent} (original request, work done, files changed, recent conversation)
server.handoff.switched: ⇄ Switched from {from} to {agent} — context handed over
server.handoff.switchedClear: ⇄ Switched from {from} to {agent} — context cleared, starting clean
server.handoff.cleared: 🧹 Context cleared — {agent} starts a new session
